MobileWelcomeDetail: Find photos, video scenes and people. Your library and AI stay on your phone.
DeviceGalleryDetail: Follow all accessible photos and videos
DeviceAlbumsDetail: Camera, screenshots and other media folders
PickMediaDetail: Share only the items you choose with PixSeek
BrowseFolderDetail: Use the Android file manager, including SD cards
ImportHint: Your originals stay where they are. Android asks which photos or folders PixSeek can read.
ChooseFaceAndName: Choose at least one face and enter a name or keyword.
OneFacePerPhoto: Select only one face per reference photo for this person.
PersonHint: Choose a few photos of the same person, then select their face in each photo.
PersonNames: Name or keywords, separated by commas
PersonPrivacy: Face recognition runs locally. Names and face vectors are stored only on this phone.
LocalAiDetail: Preinstalled multilingual model. Local ONNX Runtime CPU inference. No cloud.
ForegroundIndexing: Indexing runs while PixSeek is open. It pauses in the background and resumes when you return. Large libraries may take time.
